name: EmailOSINT
steps_summary: Open the removal page, enter your email, solve the hCaptcha, click 'Send confirmation link', then click 'Confirm removal' in the email you receive. Per the site's confirmation email, this deletes stored search history for the address and blocks future lookups on their platform.
notes: Completed and tested by the project author: a later lookup of the address was blocked. Request email dated 12 Sept 2026. Re-check occasionally.

name: Etsy
steps_summary: Account settings from your profile image, then Close Your Account (choose a reason, select Close Account). Closing is separate from permanent deletion, which is requested in Privacy settings and is irreversible.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Close option is hidden if money is owed or a case is open, or if the email was changed in the last 7 days.

name: Pinterest
steps_summary: Settings, Account management, Delete account. Pinterest asks you to confirm by email; deletion happens after a 7-day waiting period during which you can reactivate.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: Figma
steps_summary: Log in, click your name top-left, Settings, Account tab, delete account at the bottom. Cancel any paid plan first, leave any organization, transfer ownership of teams and files, and export your work. Permanent.

name: Eventbrite
steps_summary: Account Settings, Close Account, give a reason, type CLOSE and your password. Afterwards request deletion of personal data. Blocked while you have upcoming tickets, published events, or pending payouts or unpaid invoices.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: Hack The Box
steps_summary: My Profile, then the account removal button, then confirm. Permanent; badges, certificates and progress are lost. Email confirmation not mentioned.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: Wondershare
steps_summary: The help page has no delete steps. Sign in to your Wondershare ID Account Center, cancel any subscription, then contact support to request deletion.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. No self-service deletion found.

name: Microsoft account
steps_summary: Sign in, verify your identity if asked, tick the acknowledgments, choose a 30 or 60 day reopen window, pick a reason, and click Mark account for closure. Data is deleted after the window ends.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. If you reset all sign-in verification details you must wait 60 days.

name: MyFitnessPal
steps_summary: Website: log in, Settings, then the delete option. App: More menu or profile icon, Help, delete option. Permanent. Marketing email may arrive for up to 3 days.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: ESPN
steps_summary: Cancel your subscription first (deleting does not cancel it). Then in a browser: Profile, Account, Manage with MyDisney, scroll to Delete Account, confirm. Also removes access to other Disney family services except Disney+, Hulu and your MyDisney identity.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: Babbel
steps_summary: Log in, open settings in the app or website, choose delete, confirm, then click the link in the confirmation email. Deletion is not final until you click it. Cancel store-billed subscriptions yourself first.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: Skyscanner
steps_summary: No in-app deletion was found. The privacy policy says to use the data privacy request form, or write to the Data Protection Officer.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Route is a privacy request, not an account setting.

name: Fingerprint.to
steps_summary: Enter your email, click Email me a code, pass the bot check, then type the 6-digit code from your email. Blocks that exact email from search. Names and usernames need the contact page.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Cloudflare Turnstile shown in a real browser; a person must tick it.

name: OSINTSearch
steps_summary: Choose suppress my email, send the verification link, click the link in your email. Removes the email from their site only.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Turnstile markers found on the page.

name: OSINTLeak
steps_summary: Enter your email, click Verify (a bot check passed by itself in one test), then enter the code emailed to you and choose Restricted Visibility with Monitoring or Full Removal.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Submit step observed working 2026-10-22: a confirmation code was emailed. Final confirmation was not completed.

name: Epieos
steps_summary: No form. Email contact@epieos.com with a privacy erasure request (GDPR) for your address. They may ask for ID and may refuse.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Use draft_erasure_request to write the email.

name: Spokeo
steps_summary: Find your listing on spokeo.com, copy its profile URL, paste it into the opt-out form, then click the link in the confirmation email. One request per listing; it may reappear later.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: PeopleFinders
steps_summary: Search your name, open View Profile, copy the profile URL, enter it in the form, then click the emailed verification link. Hides records on their site only.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.

name: ThatsThem
steps_summary: Fill the form with name, email, address and phone as they appear on the record, one request per record. Removes you from public search and sharing; search engines may keep it for a week or more.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Confirmation method not described on the page.

name: SmartBackgroundChecks
steps_summary: Enter name and email and pass the CAPTCHA, click the emailed link within 24 hours, then fill the form matching your record. Removal takes about 3 days.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself.
